answer_text:
For a coordinate 2-form,

\[
(x_i \wedge x_j)(A,B)=A_iB_j-A_jB_i.
\]

Thus

\[
\theta(A,B)
=\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}\bigl(A_iB_{i+1}-A_{i+1}B_i\bigr).
\]

Here \(A_i=1\) for all \(i\), and \(B_i=(-1)^i\), so

\[
A_iB_{i+1}-A_{i+1}B_i
= B_{i+1}-B_i.
\]

Therefore,

\[
\theta(A,B)
=\sum_{i=1}^{n-1} (B_{i+1}-B_i)
= B_n-B_1.
\]

Since \(B_n=(-1)^n\) and \(B_1=-1\),

\[
\theta(A,B)=(-1)^n-(-1)=(-1)^n+1.
\]

So the value is

\[
\boxed{(-1)^n+1}
\]

Equivalently, it is \(2\) if \(n\) is even and \(0\) if \(n\) is odd.
